reason: Graph Memory is primarily a cross-session agent memory and context plugin that extracts structured knowledge, stores it locally, and retrieves relevant subgraphs for prompt assembly.

summaries.zh: Graph Memory 从对话中提取结构化知识并持久化保存，以便在后续会话中检索相关记忆并补充智能体上下文。
summaries.en: Graph Memory extracts and stores structured knowledge from conversations so relevant memories can be retrieved across sessions and added to agent context.

capabilities: Extracts structured TASK, SKILL, and EVENT knowledge from conversations
Persists conversation-derived graph data in a local SQLite store
Performs lexical and optional vector-based semantic retrieval across sessions
Injects recalled memory into agent prompt assembly
Provides explicit status, search, record, and statistics tools
Can use configured external embedding providers
